name: companion-memory-workspace
description: Companion memory for DeepSeek Harness: a pure decision kernel plus a DSH plugin adapter.

scripts.build:worker:windows: cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -p companion-memory-worker && node scripts/package-worker.mjs --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:worker:linux: cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -p companion-memory-worker && node scripts/package-worker.mjs --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
